Tell me about UK2 Group

source: Tom's own account

UK2 Group is an international web hosting company with offices in UK, US and Ukraine.

I joined as Head of Group Strategy - working across all brands and markets troubleshooting for the CEO.

Key work included:

  • Linked people, products and projects across UK, US, and Ukraine offices
  • Acting Marketing Manager US: rebuilt underperforming US marketing department
  • Business unit turnaround: reversed downward revenue trend in 6 months
  • Managed development of new domain platform (500,000+ customer domains)

Tell me about the UK2 marketing role

source: Tom's own account

Rebuilt the underperforming US Marketing department before recruiting a US-based successor (Feb 2009 - Feb 2010).

Created marketing strategy, implemented reporting structure, set and met budget targets. Managed all online and marketing activity across 5 web properties.

Also ran a business unit turnaround in parallel: reduced bounce rate by ~15%, nearly doubled sales conversion, created product roadmap and launched 8 products in 10 months.

The challenge was doing this remotely from the UK, with a team I'd never met in person. Required building trust fast and being very clear about expectations.
